## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `make verify` passes, mutation testing included (100% MSI).
- [ ] New steps are used by a feature in `features/` and documented in the README.
- [ ] User-visible changes are recorded under `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Examples, fixtures and snapshots contain no personal or confidential data.
